producer_report.summary: Root cause: the change producer's brief said nothing about fixing a flaky or racy failure. That information gap led four jobs to patch single call sites without reproducing the flake under load or recording counts. I added one paragraph to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md, and the closing 'Before you report…' sentence is now the last paragraph. The paragraph says to reproduce under load with a test that loops the action on threads and counts failures (it names crates/athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs and notes the Bash policy denies shell loops). It also says to name the cause in code terms and fix it where it starts. If sites share the cause, fix them in one shared helper with a repo test that finds every site and fails with the cause put back. Finally it says to report the command and counts before and after. The new unit test the_producer_brief_carries_the_flaky_test_guidance pins each phrase and the report step as the last paragraph. It also checks that the named example file exists and that the live producer command list names no shell program. The prompt grew the producer set from 1043 to 1194 of 1200, so I changed that one number in docs/system-facts.md (forced by the budget drift test). I added D189 to docs/decisions.md and one CHANGELOG.md entry. No refusal rule, gate or job step is added (0% of past accepted readings refused). The testkit helper, scan, stress test and drain.rs are untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md names the root cause, a failure class that comes from an information gap in the producer brief. It tells the producer, for an intermittent or racy failure, to reproduce under parallel load, state the cause in code terms, fix it in one shared helper rather than per call site, add a repo scan test for all sites, and show the test fails with the cause reintroduced. The check is a diff of the file.
criteria_check.evidence: git diff of producer.md shows one new paragraph between the study-claim text and the closing criteria_check sentence, which is now its own last paragraph. The paragraph says: reproduce under load with a test that loops the action on threads and counts failures, name the cause in code terms, fix it where it starts, fix shared sites in one helper plus a repo test that finds every site and fails with the cause put back, and report the command and counts before and after. The information gap itself is named in CHANGELOG.md and D189. Deviation from the criterion's literal wording: the prompt says 'under load' rather than 'parallel load', follows the accepted plan's text, and does not carry the root-cause statement itself.

open_issues: docs/system-facts.md is not a listed deliverable. The producer line changed from 1043 to 1194 because the budget drift test requires it (forced).

The planner frame (crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md, planner set 1105 of 1200) lacks the same guidance. It is not a listed deliverable, so the follow-up of one sentence is recorded in D189 and CHANGELOG.md and not made here.
The producer prompt set has 6 tokens of room left (1194 of 1200).
The guidance is prose and its compliance is not measured. The method (thread loop in one test) does not cover races that need separate processes.
learnings: The producer prompt set was 1043 of 1200 and is 1194 after the added paragraph; budgets.rs forces the facts-file number to match.
Bash policy denies tail and other non-listed programs, so commands cannot be piped.
desires: A way to read a large saved test output with Grep or Read: the policy denies the tool-results path, so I could not confirm the per-test results of the full suite beyond its exit status.
